params.message:
Communities in the menu and footer, Alpha in the register box

KUBO CyberSec exists, so the homepage line that listed community courses as
coming next now points to KUBO communities as they are, starting with KUBO
CyberSec in The Gambia. Open learning resources keep their Soon label. Same in
nl and fr.

Communities joins the About group in the menu, after Deployments, and the About
column in the footer, in all three languages. It shows as active on the
community pages too.

With the extra link the French bar no longer fit: the Commencer button was cut
off between 1341 and 1420 px and again between 1561 and about 1760 px. The
hamburger now takes over at 1420 px instead of 1340, the tighter spacing runs up
to 1700 px instead of 1560, and the bar may grow to 1640 px instead of 1430.
Measured in en, nl and fr from 1420 to 2560 px: every item fits.

The register box on /communities/cybersec now shows who you message: Alpha Omar
Bah's photo, name and role as on the team page, above "Send a message to
Alpha". The photo is the team portrait, cropped closer to the face, as webp at
160 and 288 px with explicit dimensions and alt text in each language. It goes
with the register box, so it leaves the page after the event as well.
